reviewedBy: Codex source-backed editorial audit and independent cross-review

method.scope: Current article prose, full import inputs and retained standalone FAQs; Quran/Bible quotations checked separately; disputed interpretations and qualified claims remain attributed.
method.publicationScope: 113 active articles; 12 retired redirects retained as private reviewed records, never newly published.
method.bibliographyLimit: Bibliography identities, supplied metadata and broad topic relevance were checked; this is not a claim that every full book or unread quotation was verified.
method.supplementalReview: Root reviewed the current metadata corrections and source-grounded clarifications of worship, Messiahship and revelation; existing Quran/Bible quotations and their reference tokens were preserved.
